title: Eve of Abduction
description: After a single mother gets engaged she begins to receive messages from an anonymous stalker, threatening to kidnap her daughter if she does not break off the engagement. The threats persist and her daughter is taken.

title: Fatal Defense
description: A single mother signs up for self-defence classes from a handsome instructor. But he develops a frightening obsession with her and orchestrates an increasingly deadly array of tests to see if she has truly learned from his lessons.

title: Calling for Love
description: Successful podcast host Samantha Desouza is passionate about music but cynical about love. That starts to change when she meets Jake, a charismatic and charming new caller whom she tries to help with a problem.

title: Love on the Vines
description: After inheriting half of her uncle's vineyard, a woman must work with the co-owner for three weeks or risk losing the land.

title: The Love Club: Nicole
description: At a New Year's Eve college party, four women make a vow to call on one another if they're ever in a romantic crisis. Ten years later, they find themselves resurrecting their love club as each searches for eternal happiness.

title: His Secret Past
description: When her daughter is rescued from a deadly attack by a stranger, a famous novelist joins the police to investigate. They soon discover the saviour's hidden past.

title: Fatal Memories
description: After spending four years in an asylum for stabbing her mother, April is released and taken in by her sister Sutton. Determined to prove April's innocence, Sutton starts her own investigation that will shake up the very foundation of her family.

title: A Man for Every Month
description: To get a feature out for her company's Man for Every Month blog, an introverted writer has to go on a date with a different man every month.

title: The Perfect Soulmate
description: A poet with an abusive husband reaches out to a fan for help, only to find an even more dangerous companion.

title: The Psycho She Met Online
description: When her husband is hospitalised due to a car accident, a woman decides to rent out the spare rooms online to help cover costs. When one of her renters is found murdered, she becomes convinced that another tenant was involved.

title: Til Ex Do Us Part
description: A woman is accused of arranging an attack on a woman who slept with her boyfriend during a break.
